source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The implementation includes its own header and changes the cursor pointer to int32_t*. The existing declaration and MimeObject input cursor use that type, and the real parse-buffer caller passes the field address. The patch also removes unsigned casts in two boundary comparisons. Accepted source retains this agreement but has later CheckedInt growth and two-byte slack. Type agreement alone proves no negative-input validation, overflow safety, native ABI or runtime result.
title: MIME line buffering uses the signed cursor type declared by its caller
